postal_system.assignment_rule: The August 2026 UPU General Addressing Issues tables establish that Honduras requires postcodes and uses five numeric digits. The public May 2004 Honduras sheet's six-character AANNNN system is retained as legacy source-specific history and is not normalized into the current scheme. Syntax is not a complete current assignment denominator, geometry, civic address, building relation or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current HONDUCOR or UPU postal Polygon/MultiPolygon release was located. The reviewed SINIT catalogue contains 1,034 layers and no postal, correo or HONDUCOR match. Department, municipality, barrio, colonia, settlement, lot, block, parcel, agency, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, model or AGID cell cannot be presented as official postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, street, house number, premises, barrio or colonia, locality or municipality, department and current five-digit postcode separately. Preserve legacy AANNNN examples as historical source records without rewriting them as current values.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store area, delivery_office, route, po_box, organization, point, legacy_code and unknown independently. Agency locations and P.O. Box or EMS instructions are non-area evidence and must never be buffered or promoted to postal areas.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic-address identifier and a stable explicit relation to a permitted building identifier and footprint or point. Postcode, locality, agency, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an exact address-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: SINIT and other government identifiers and geometry remain contextual unless a competent postal authority publishes a versioned postcode crosswalk, edition, CRS, coverage and compatible rights. Administrative or settlement geometry is not HONDUCOR postal geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Rights-cleared observations may normalize current five-digit input, validate candidates and produce review surfaces with source, version, request digest, observed_at, generated_at, confidence, uncertainty and official-derived or derived status. They never overwrite evidence or manufacture official geometry.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A versioned crosswalk may relate typed Honduras assignments, permitted geometry and explicit address-building relations to AGID cells without relabelling a postal object as a grid cell or a grid cell as postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Public HONDUCOR and SINIT access is not an explicit licence for AGID processing, derivation, redistribution and public serving. UPU complete POST*CODE data is contract, NDA, declaration and annual-fee controlled and is not a postal polygon product. Nothing was accepted, purchased or accessed behind authentication.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The pack remains ISO HN scope. Postal, administrative, civic-address, building and AGID identities stay independent; no neighbouring country or territory is merged.
postal_system.privacy_rule: No raw postcode directory, exact address, customer, recipient, P.O. Box, property, credential, query log or land-right data is bundled. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Store retrieved_at, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, release, edition, source version, digest and supersession independently. The current UPU general tables are August 2026; the country-specific sheet is explicitly legacy edition 05/2004.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: Publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet with source licence, release, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Restricted UPU or future operator material remains private, gated or external; production pins immutable commits and verifies digests.

stages.definition: Digest-bound current UPU, HONDUCOR and SINIT evidence with present-versus-legacy semantics, rights, geometry, typed-object and no-proxy boundaries.

M2 requires a current complete competent-authority release of every Honduras five-digit postcode assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and typed area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, edition, schema, coverage, exact bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The August 2026 UPU tables establish that Honduras requires postcodes, length five, format 99999 and numeric type; the May 2004 Honduras sheet's AANNNN scheme remains explicit legacy evidence and cannot be substituted for current assignments. Every drawable current code must reconcile to finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source feature identity, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. SINIT department, municipality, barrio, colonia, settlement, lot, block or parcel layers, HONDUCOR agency points, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and models cannot be promoted without a versioned competent-authority crosswalk and compatible rights. Delivery-office, route, P.O. Box, organization, point, legacy code and other non-area objects must show type and reason without a fabricated surface. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real HN API/app, normalize five digits, handle loading, no-match, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fit and render a translucent fill with clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear and re-search, and display selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.
